name: claude-statusbar
description: Show Claude plan usage limits (session / weekly), model and context in the VS Code status bar.

scripts.release: npm run build && npm run install-vsix

claudeStatusbar.refreshSeconds.description: How often to re-read Claude Code transcripts.

claudeStatusbar.barWidth.description: Number of blocks in the context usage bar.

claudeStatusbar.usageRefreshSeconds.description: How often to fetch plan usage limits (min 30s).
